'''Hapan''' was a [[Unarmed combat|martial art]]<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> that shared its name with the [[Hapan]]s, the [[Near-Human]] natives of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].<ref name="Cracken's Threat Dossier">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="MedStar I" /> [[Followers of Palawa|Follower of Palawa]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|162|Ji, Phow}}</ref> [[Phow Ji]] was a master of this discipline along with a dozen other deadly martial arts.<ref name="MedStar I" />
